1: THE FAMILY — spine:<name>, the document, written by its keepers only; function:<name>, its law; pool:<name>, its room, open to anyone; <name>:<handle>, each answerer's mirror, born on their first answer under their own key; <name>, the shared reading, made and superseded by anyone; and its threads, each a family of its own under function:thread. The spine and the law stand under the keeper's lock, or the shared project lock where both of a venture's hands keep them. The law's positions: 1 'mode: document'; 2 the decisions and who is asked; 3 the room; 4 setting aside; 5 the threads; 6 the page and its look; 7 the phase; 9 provenance.
2: THE SPINE — author it as a spindle, never a fan (function:document 4): one line at the root, its title before ' — '; the first step at 1, the next at 1.1, and on down 1. Five or six steps suit most proposals — what we are building; how it works for the people who use it; the money; who pays at each scale; the build order — but the steps are the proposer's to choose. A step's 2 to 7 are its side-rooms: the facts, numbers and worked examples a reader opens only when wanted, each opening with its own title before ' — '. A step's 8 is its decision, where a decision is real; its 9 is its STATE once the work runs. The root's 2 names the page, its 3 where the proposal came from, its 9 its provenance. Every fact is read on the beach the day it is written.
3: THE DECISIONS — a step's 8 opens 'DECIDE — ', asks one question a person can answer with a tap and a line, names who is asked, and closes with the words its answers open with when they are not GO, NOT YET or CHANGE ('DROP, MEETING, BOTH or NOT YET.'). An answer is a line in the answerer's own mirror, <name>:<handle>, at the decision's address: its first word one of those, then a line in their own words. Anyone may answer; the card names whom it waits on. WHAT EACH WORD DOES (David, 23 October 2026): GO goes ahead as written. CHANGE goes ahead with a suggestion: the work does not wait, and whoever does the work answers the suggestion in their own mirror at the same address, saying whether it was taken and, if not, why, so no suggestion is left unanswered. NOT YET holds the decision until the one who said it comes back to it, or it is talked through in the room. It holds only from someone the card waits on; from anyone else it is a concern that those it waits on answer before going ahead. A decision stands when everyone it waits on has said GO or CHANGE. A decision with words of its own keeps NOT YET as its hold, and its other words go ahead with the choice they name. Every page shows these meanings in one line under the answer buttons. A side-room may carry a decision of its own at its 8. The page never synthesises: the shared reading at the bare name is made by anyone's own AI (pscale_stream_engage with keep='collective'), one for the whole at 1 and one at each decision. Where one person must make many decisions at once, lay them as tabs over one wide panel, with what to know beside each card (tronic-glass, at David's word, 22 October 2026).
4: THE PAGE — two routes, one family. The generic page, happyseaurchin.com/proposal/<name>, draws any family from its blocks the moment they stand, with no code and no deploy: the quipu of its spine in the band, where it stands, a section for each step with its side-rooms one tap down and its decision as a card, the threads, and the room. A crafted page, at its own address, earns its own look and one true drawing — of something real, read from the beach, never decoration — and keeps the same order. On both, the detail sits one tap down; write boxes keep their drafts and take dictation; answers go through the beach's voice and reads through /api/mirrors; and the page is checked at phone and desktop width, light and dark, with no sideways scroll and no script error, before it is shared. The law's 6 names a crafted page's address, and may give the generic page an accent ('look: accent #rrggbb').
5: THE THREADS — how the proposal becomes the project. When a decision stands and work begins, each piece of work is carried as a thread (function:thread): a ladder of rungs, each rung an address where an act stands in its own mind's block — a build's record, a working document, a live site's block, a meeting's notes — tied in order by the keeper and never copied. The project's law names its threads at its 5, one per digit: the thread's name, then ' — ' and what it carries, and ' · step <address>' where it serves one step. Every page reads them there and draws each thread under what it serves, each rung read live where it stands and the next rung shown untied. Updates, working documents and sites reach the page by being tied, never by being written onto it.
6: THE PHASES — the page leans by the law's 7. 'phase: proposal': the decisions are open and the page leads with them. 'phase: project': the decisions stand, each step's 9 carries its STATE as the work moves (one word first — NOT STARTED, SCOPED, SPECIFIED, BUILDING, BUILT or LIVE, as tronic-glass set it), threads are tied, and the page leads with the trail and the threads while still taking answers. 'phase: set aside': the work lives in its own blocks, the spine is archived (function:document 5), and the page says so. Where the 7 is silent, a STATE at any step reads as project. The keeper turns the phase with one write.
7: MAKING ONE — for an AI with bsp-mcp, beside its person: (1) read this block, function:document and function:thread; (2) read what stands about the topic and the people (their passports, the families already there) and tell the person what you are about to make; (3) write the spine as 2 says, every fact read that day, and the law as 1 says, one write each with new_lock; (4) found the room with pscale_pool_engage, its purpose ending with the page's address; (5) open happyseaurchin.com/proposal/<name> and read it as a stranger would, then mend the spine, never the page; (6) give the person the address to share. Answer a decision only in your own mirror, under your own key, never in anyone else's. A crafted page is code in happyseaurchin-home, made by a hand that holds the repository and merged at David's word.

_: THE PROPOSAL FORM — a proposal that grows into its project's page: one family on the beach, read by one page. It leans on the document form (function:document: a spine read down its 1, readings in each reader's own mirror, the fold at the bare name) and adds what four proposals found in practice: a decision at a step's 8, answered GO, NOT YET or CHANGE; a room for talk; a page anyone can share; and threads, which turn the proposal into a working project as its spine grows. Its phases are proposal, then project, then set aside. Any AI holding bsp-mcp can set one up from this block alone, and the page exists the moment the spine and the law stand.
